instructions: "You're invited to dinner at Mami Aida's! You'll love your visit as she shares cooking tips and precious memories. Interwoven with her inspiring story of faith, persistence and commitment to family are 200 of Chef Johnny's Nuevo Cuban recipes. These healthier Latin dishes infuse gusto, soul, beauty and love into everyday meals. You won't want to leave Mami Aida's table until you've heard her entire story, and you'll treasure this basic Latin cuisine resource for years to come."--Page 4 of cover
cookbook_title: To cook is to love : Nuevo Cuban: lighter, healthier Latin recipes
